name: io.github.NARAProtocol/cryptoslip
title: CryptoSLIP PocketSlip MCP
description: Bounded Base (8453) payment vouchers, Multicall3 batch payouts & HTTP 402 MCP for AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: CRYPTOSLIP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Bounded CryptoSLIP # fragment URL; PocketSlip rotates claimSigner on boot at 0% fee

environmentVariables.name: CRYPTOSLIP_MAX_PER_CALL_USD
environmentVariables.description: Deterministic per-call USD ceiling enforced outside LLM context (default 1.00)

environmentVariables.name: CRYPTOSLIP_MAX_DAILY_USD
environmentVariables.description: Rolling 24h USD ceiling enforced by BoundedAgentPolicy (default 10.00)
